mostWorthwhile.text: Tracing seawater through evaporation, rain and runoff was worthwhile: it connected the water cycle to the separation of most dissolved minerals from evaporating water.

leastWorthwhile.text: The condensation result repeated the preceding explanation about dissolved minerals, making that passage feel slightly repetitive.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for more natural-process discoveries, though this chapter's water-cycle sequence was mostly predictable.
